name: @firfi/voila-mcp
description: Voila MCP server for safe personal grocery search, cart, slots, and order-history workflows

scripts.build: PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs "--define:PKG_VERSION=\"$PKG_VERSION\"" && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs "--define:PKG_VERSION=\"$PKG_VERSION\"" && esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/bin.cjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' "--define:PKG_VERSION=\"$PKG_VERSION\""
scripts.verify-version: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; const d=require('fs').readFileSync('dist/bin.cjs','utf8'); if(!d.includes('\"'+v+'\"'))throw new Error('dist version mismatch: expected '+v)"
scripts.package:audit: pnpm build && pnpm verify-version && node ../../scripts/audit-package.mjs . bin

author: firfi
